data.description:
Mirror inventory finding F14 (reports/stability/mirror-inventory.md), LOW.

- src/rebar/_cli/_registry.py:680 _CONFIRM_SCOPE (derived, canonical)
- scripts/gen_cli_reference.py:43-46 EDITORIAL_PREAMBLE prose, emitted into docs/cli-reference.md:8
- docs/user-guide.md:27 hand-authored, same 17 backticked names

All three agree at 17/17 today, so this is preventive. The existing gate misses both prose copies:
_check_mutation_verbs() (gen_cli_reference.py:194-205) compares the MUTATION_VERBS dict KEYS to
_CONFIRM_SCOPE, not the preamble; lint_editorial s route rule fires only on `rebar <verb>` forms and
the preamble uses bare backticks; docs/user-guide.md has no gate at all. Adding a confirmable=True
route updates the canonical set and the dict, and both prose copies go stale silently.

Proposed fix: add-parity-check — extend _check_mutation_verbs to the preamble and the user-guide list.
data.title: Gate the two prose copies of the 17 mutating verbs (mirror F14)
